title: Marex named World's Best FX Provider for Client Service at the Euromoney FX Awards 2026
summary: Marex has been named World's Best FX Provider for Client Service at the Euromoney Foreign Exchange Awards 2026, recognising its client-led approach.
body_markdown:
Marex has won World’s Best FX Provider for Client Service at the


Euromoney


Foreign Exchange Awards 2026, recognizing our approach to client service for corporate treasury and institutional clients across both Corporate FX and Hedging Solutions, and its position as a non-bank challenger in a category historically dominated by global banks.


The award, typically presented as World’s Best Bank for Client Service, was adapted to reflect Marex’s profile as a non-bank financial services platform.


The recognition caps a period of rapid growth for Marex’s Corporate FX business. Following the acquisition of Hamilton Court Group in July 2025, Marex’s FX revenue grew 362% in 2025 to $66.1 million, up from $14.3 million in 2024


*(Marex Group 2025 Annual Report).*


Marex’s approach to client service pairs specialist treasury expertise with institutional-grade market access, combining relationship-led advisory with proprietary technology. Neon, Marex’s client portal, brings together the Emporos and MIRA platforms acquired with Hamilton Court Group, giving clients a single view of risk profiling, hedge analytics, trading and reporting. AGILE, Marex’s award-winning platform for managing commodity and currency hedging portfolios, sits alongside it.


*“At Marex, exceptional client service starts with understanding each client’s business and objectives, then designing the right solution. Hamilton Court’s 2025 integration deepened that expertise, resulting in a responsive, connected proposition that helps clients manage risk in complex markets, execute with confidence and access a broader range of tailored solutions.”*


Greg Tsimbler, Deputy CEO of Capital Markets and Global Head of FX & Payments, Marex


The win adds to a strong year of industry recognition for Marex’s FX business, which has also been named


Best Service from a Business FX Provider at the Business Moneyfacts Awards


for four consecutive years (2023–2026). Client service remains central to our approach, and we continue to focus on understanding our clients’ needs and providing the support, expertise and service they require.
